title: Adaptively Incorporating Directional Hints into Zeroth-Order Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.08277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study zeroth-order optimization of non-convex functions with the aid of directional hints, which are cheap but potentially inaccurate approximations of the true gradient direction, given by linear subspaces at each iteration. To leverage these hints adaptively while maintaining robustness to their quality, we introduce Control-Variate Zeroth-Order Descent (CV-ZOD), a new framework that refines the classical zeroth-order gradient estimator with a control variate that can be set based on the directional hints. We first show that the oracle algorithm that optimally sets the reference vector and step size at each iteration achieves a convergence rate that interpolates between the first-order $O(1/T)$ rate and the zeroth-order $O(d/T)$ rate, depending on the quality of the hints along the trajectory. We then develop a practical variant of CV-ZOD that achieves the same oracle guarantee up to logarithmic factors, without any prior knowledge

translated_title: 自适应地将方向提示融入零阶优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究在方向提示辅助下的非凸函数零阶优化问题。方向提示是真实梯度方向的廉价但可能不准确的近似，在每次迭代中以线性子空间的形式给出。为了自适应地利用这些提示同时保持对其质量的鲁棒性，我们引入了控制变量零阶下降，这是一个新框架，它通过一个可基于方向提示设置的控制变量来改进经典的零阶梯度估计器。我们首先证明，在每次迭代中最优设置参考向量和步长的先知算法所达到的收敛速率，会根据提示在轨迹上的质量，在 O(1/T) 的一阶速率与 O(d/T) 的零阶速率之间进行插值。随后，我们开发了CV-ZOD的一个实用变体，该变体无需任何先验知识，即可在对数因子范围内达到与先知算法相同的保证。
tldr: 提出CV-ZOD框架，利用控制变量自适应地将廉价的方向提示融入零阶优化，使收敛速率能根据提示质量在 O(1/T) 一阶速率与 O(d/T) 零阶速率之间平滑插值，且实用变体无需任何先验知识。
en_tdlr: CV-ZOD is a control-variate framework that adaptively incorporates cheap directional hints into zeroth-order optimization, achieving a convergence rate interpolating between the O(1/T) first-order and O(d/T) zeroth-order rates based on hint quality, with a practical variant requiring no prior knowledge.
